source_unit.label: Special Digivolution Condition
source_unit.text: [DNA Digivolution] Lv.6 w/[Greymon] in name+Lv.6 w/[Garurumon] in name: Cost 0

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolution] Lv.6 w/[Greymon] in name+Lv.6 w/[Garurumon] in name: Cost 0

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast DNA Digivolve ([WarGreymon] + [MetalGarurumon])＞ (1 of your specified Digimon and 1 specified card in the hand may DNA digivolve into this card.)
＜Raid＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon, and return it and all of their Digimon with the same level as it to the bottom of the deck. Then, delete 1 of their Digimon.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 5 memory.)

extracted.name: Omnimon ACE

qa.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if this Digimon didn't DNA digivolve, this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect will delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
qa.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
qa.question:
I activated this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area.
Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
